root_cause.text: The `svc_rdma_copy_inline_range` function in the SUNRPC RDMA subsystem accesses the `rqstp->rq_pages` array using the `head->rc_curpage` index without verifying that the index is within the bounds of the allocated page array defined by `rqstp->rq_maxpages`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a bounds check (`if (head->rc_curpage >= rqstp->rq_maxpages) return -EINVAL;`) inside the page iteration loop of `svc_rdma_copy_inline_range` in `net/sunrpc/xprtrdma/svc_rdma_rw.c` to prevent out-of-bounds indexing of the `rq_pages` array.
